title: Reward Modeling for Mitigating Toxicity in Transformer-Based Language Models
base_benchmarks: BOLD (Bias in Open-Ended Language Generation Dataset)
findings: The proposed Reinforce-Detoxify method successfully reduced the toxicity of generated text for prompts related to religion, outperforming baselines like the original GPT-2 and DAPT. However, this reduction in toxicity came at the cost of a significant increase in perplexity for the religion category, indicating that the generated text was less fluent or coherent compared to the original model's output for the same prompts.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the toxicity of generated text when the language model was conditioned on prompts containing religious identity terms. Specifically, it used the 'Expected Maximum Toxicity' and 'Probability of Toxicity' metrics to quantify bias.
